name: week-strip
title: Week strip
description: Seven days in a row for choosing a day on a phone: weekday and date, today ringed, dots for days with events.
docs: value, defaultValue, min, max and marked use calendar days written as 2026-10-26, so they never shift with a time zone. marked is a list of days (one dot each) or an object that maps a day to how many events it has (up to three dots, and "has 3 events" in the day's name). The row is one tab stop: arrow keys move between days and choose as they go, Home and End go to the ends of the week, and Page Up and Page Down change the week; onWeekChange receives the first day of the new week. weekStart is 1 (Monday) by default and 0 is Sunday. Weekday names, the month and the full dates come from locale; today comes from the browser's clock in timeZone, or from the today prop. A page that is cached or built ahead of time must pass today: without it the first week drawn comes from the clock of whoever renders it, and a visitor after the week turned hydrates with a different week than the HTML holds. hideNav drops the month and the arrows, for a header of your own.
